blogs.title: FlashAttention-3: Unleashing the True Power of H100 GPUs for LLMs
blogs.description: This post provides a high-level overview of the performance breakthroughs in FlashAttention-3. It breaks down how the algorithm increased GPU utilization from 35% to 75% on NVIDIA H100s and explains the real-world impact of these speedups on training times and long-context AI applications.

blogs.title: The Art of GPU Multitasking: Understanding Asynchrony and 'Pingpong' Scheduling
blogs.description: Focusing on the hardware optimization aspect, this post explains the 'warp-specialization' technique. It uses accessible analogies (like an assembly line or a kitchen) to describe how the algorithm overlaps memory movement with computation, ensuring the GPU's powerful Tensor Cores are never left waiting.

blogs.title: Accuracy Meets Efficiency: Mastering FP8 with FlashAttention-3
blogs.description: This article explores the move toward low-precision computing (FP8). It discusses the challenge of quantization errors in AI models and explains how FlashAttention-3 uses clever techniques like 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing' to double throughput without sacrificing model accuracy.
